title: Cell source list
statement:

eg t_0\land r_{\mathrm{lo}}$, $
eg t_0$, and $
eg t_0\land r_{\mathrm{hi}}$ at the indicated indices. Append the two conditional current sources at positions $3$ and $4$, each selected using $r_{\mathrm{lo}}$, and then append the conditional postponed-source list of length $W$ determined by $t_0$.
